name: Judgment Search Recall
source: Hand-judged solicitor queries against the benchmark fixture corpus; relevance sets fixed independently of the index.

scoring.recall: mean per-query recall@10 over the 15 non-decoy queries
scoring.precision: fraction of the 4 citation-decoy queries returning zero results

known_limitations: Three relevance sets name real authorities not yet ingested (donoghue-v-stevenson-1932, cobbe-v-yeomans-row-2008, carlill-v-carbolic-1893), so recall is honestly below 1.0 until the ingest campaign lands them.

Fixture corpus is 68 synthetic documents, including two costs-ruling decoys whose ids carry a party token (potanina-costs-2025-1, paul-costs-2025-1); ranking scores depend on corpus statistics, so thresholds re-measured here must be re-measured on a real corpus.

Recall@10 does not measure rank order within the top 10. Rank order is covered by the gate-1 top-1/top-3 checks, including the party-potanina and party-paul cases whose decoys outrank the right judgment on engine scoring alone, so only the exact-match re-ranking stage puts the right document first.
